title: Airship Ledger

reward.description: Its needle points not north, but toward the nearest unpaid fuel bill.

hints: Start with an empty dict. For each (ship, tons) record: if the ship is already a key, add to it; otherwise set it.
dict.get(ship, 0) returns 0 when the ship isn't in the dictionary yet. Handy!
For thirstiest, loop over ledger.items() and remember the best (name, tons) pair you've seen so far.
